idea-plugin.name: LeanProxy Cost Monitor
idea-plugin.description:
LeanProxy Cost Monitor

Token savings from LeanProxy (today and week-to-date) in your JetBrains IDE status bar and tool window.

Features:

  • Status bar widget showing tokens saved today (or an estimated cost saved at your own price)
  • Tool window with today and week-to-date totals and a per-server and per-tool breakdown
  • Configurable metrics endpoint, bearer token (kept in the IDE password safe), polling interval, currency and price
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Unreleased: reads the /metrics "usage" section (today / week-to-date from the usage store); default endpoint 127.0.0.1:9091; metrics token, currency and price settings
  • 0.1.0: Initial release - parity with VS Code extension
